title: PATRM engine register map (AXI-Lite slave on M_AXI_GP0)
notes: All registers are 32 bits wide at 32-bit aligned byte offsets from the engine base address (see spec/memory_map.md).
Bits not covered by a field are reserved: they read as 0 and writes to them are ignored.
Field access: RW = read/write; RO = read-only, writes ignored; W1C = reads the flag, writing 1 clears it, writing 0 has no effect; WP = write 1 to trigger a one-cycle pulse, always reads 0.
Configuration registers (CTRL.MODE, SRC_ADDR .. BLOCK_LEN) keep their value while STATUS.BUSY = 1: writes to them are ignored until the job ends. CTRL.IRQ_EN can be written at any time.

When CTRL.START is written with 1 the engine checks the configuration in the same cycle. If a check fails it sets STATUS.ERROR and STATUS.ERR_CODE and does not start (BUSY stays 0, DONE is unchanged). If all checks pass it clears DONE, ERROR, ERR_CODE and all counters, sets BUSY and starts.
Signed fields are two's complement Q15.16 (scale 65536).

constants.name: VERSION
constants.description: register map version, reported in BUILD_ID.VERSION

constants.name: MAX_SIZE
constants.description: D11: largest WIDTH and largest HEIGHT (pixels)

constants.name: SIZE_BITS
constants.description: D11: width of the WIDTH / HEIGHT / BLOCK_LEN fields

constants.name: GRAY_W_MULT
constants.description: D3: grayscale WIDTH must be a multiple of this

constants.name: BAYER_W_MULT
constants.description: D3: Bayer WIDTH must be a multiple of this

constants.name: BAYER_H_MULT
constants.description: D3: Bayer HEIGHT must be a multiple of this

constants.name: ADDR_ALIGN
constants.description: SRC_ADDR and DST_ADDR must be multiples of this (4 KB)

values.name: GRAY
values.description: grayscale, one plane of WIDTH x HEIGHT, uses B11..B23

values.name: BAYER_A
values.description: Bayer RGGB, Option A: one core, four plane passes; uses B11, B12, B21, B22 and T_*

values.name: BAYER_B
values.description: Bayer RGGB, Option B: four lanes, one pass; uses B11, B12, B21, B22 and T_* (lane offsets T_p - T_R, D6)

enums.name: ERR
enums.description: STATUS.ERR_CODE values. If several checks fail, the code reported is the first in this order: START_BUSY, BAD_MODE, BAD_SIZE, BAD_ADDR, BAD_BLOCK_LEN.

values.name: BAD_SIZE
values.description: WIDTH or HEIGHT is 0 or above MAX_SIZE (D11), or breaks D3 for the selected mode (gray: WIDTH % 8 != 0; Bayer: WIDTH % 16 != 0 or HEIGHT odd)

values.name: BAD_MODE
values.description: CTRL.MODE = 3, or a mode whose bit is 0 in BUILD_ID.MODES

values.name: BAD_ADDR
values.description: SRC_ADDR or DST_ADDR is not 4 KB aligned (bits 11:0 not zero)

values.name: START_BUSY
values.description: CTRL.START written while STATUS.BUSY = 1; the running job continues unaffected

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control. Write MODE and IRQ_EN together with START = 1 as the last write of a job.

fields.name: START
fields.description: write 1 to check the configuration and start a job; reads 0

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: 0 = gray, 1 = Bayer Option A, 2 = Bayer Option B, 3 = invalid

fields.name: IRQ_EN
fields.description: 1 = drive the interrupt output (IRQ_F2P[0]) high while STATUS.DONE = 1

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Status. The interrupt output is CTRL.IRQ_EN & DONE (level).

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: 1 from an accepted start until the last write response of the job has been received

fields.name: DONE
fields.description: set when a job ends (same cycle BUSY falls, all output data accepted by DDR); write 1 to clear (also clears the interrupt)

fields.name: ERROR
fields.description: set when a start is rejected; write 1 to clear (also clears ERR_CODE)

fields.name: ERR_CODE
fields.description: reason for the last rejected start, see ERR enum; 0 when ERROR = 0

registers.name: SRC_ADDR
registers.description: DDR byte address of the source image (raw GRAY8 or raw RGGB mosaic, row-major, no header). Must be 4 KB aligned.

registers.name: DST_ADDR
registers.description: DDR byte address of the output image (same format and size as the source). Must be 4 KB aligned.

registers.name: WIDTH
registers.description: Image width W in pixels (full mosaic width in Bayer modes). D3, D11.

fields.name: W
fields.description: 1..4096; gray: multiple of 8; Bayer: multiple of 16

registers.name: HEIGHT
registers.description: Image height H in pixels (full mosaic height in Bayer modes). D3, D11.

registers.name: B11
registers.description: Inverse map coefficient b11 (x per output row u). Reset = 1.0 (identity).

registers.name: B12
registers.description: Inverse map coefficient b12 (x per output column v).

registers.name: B13
registers.description: Inverse map offset b13 (x at u = v = 0). Used in GRAY mode only; Bayer modes use T_*_X.

registers.name: B21
registers.description: Inverse map coefficient b21 (y per output row u).

registers.name: B22
registers.description: Inverse map coefficient b22 (y per output column v). Reset = 1.0 (identity).

registers.name: B23
registers.description: Inverse map offset b23 (y at u = v = 0). Used in GRAY mode only; Bayer modes use T_*_Y.

registers.name: T_R_X
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_R, x part (D2, D12: computed by the ARM, never by the hardware). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_R_Y
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_R, y part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_GR_X
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_Gr, x part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_GR_Y
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_Gr, y part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_GB_X
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_Gb, x part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_GB_Y
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_Gb, y part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_B_X
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_B, x part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: T_B_Y
registers.description: Bayer plane shift T_B, y part (D2, D12). Ignored in GRAY mode.

registers.name: BLOCK_LEN
registers.description: Block length L (D13): output pixels per block, capped at the end of a row. Changes memory traffic only, never the output. Reset 0 is rejected, so the driver must write it.

registers.name: CYCLES
registers.description: Clock cycles from the accepted start to DONE (100 MHz, D8). Cleared at an accepted start, holds its value after DONE.

registers.name: BYTES_RD
registers.description: Bytes read on HP0 in this job = 8 x accepted read beats (comparable to the step 1.4 memory model). Cleared at an accepted start.

registers.name: BYTES_WR
registers.description: Bytes written on HP1 in this job = 8 x accepted write beats, including beats with partial WSTRB (memmodel write_bus_bytes). Cleared at an accepted start.

registers.name: RD_STALL
registers.description: Cycles in this job in which the pixel pipeline waited for source data that was not yet in the prefetch buffer. Exact definition in spec/interface.md (step 2.2). Cleared at an accepted start.

registers.name: WR_STALL
registers.description: Cycles in this job in which the pixel pipeline waited because the output FIFO was full. Exact definition in spec/interface.md (step 2.2). Cleared at an accepted start.

registers.name: BUILD_ID
registers.description: Build identification, constant per bitstream (set from synthesis parameters). The driver reads it before the first job.

fields.name: MODES
fields.description: supported CTRL.MODE values, bit n = mode n supported

fields.name: BLOCK_LEN_MAX
fields.description: largest accepted BLOCK_LEN (D13, synthesis parameter chosen in step 2.2)
